Hero.subtitle: Developing websites and web applications that solve your business goals

Services.title: Services
Services.desc1: I build websites and web applications for businesses, from landing pages to services and Telegram Mini Apps.
Services.desc2: I handle the technical work and help take a project from its first version to launch.
Services.nextStep: We'll discuss the task and scope first. Then I'll prepare a step-by-step estimate of the cost and timeline.

Experience.title: Experience
Experience.marketingContext: I don't just write code and draw pretty interfaces. My main goal is to solve your business problems: lower customer acquisition cost, boost conversion rates, and build trust with your audience. I dive deep into analytics to engineer products that bring real ROI.
Experience.desc1: My name is Ilya, and I am a web developer. For over three years, I've been helping businesses build and launch their projects online.
Experience.desc2: I create applications that users enjoy and that leave you confident in the result.

case1.description: Built complete websites and web services, including interfaces, databases, and server-side logic. Helped small companies and startups launch the first versions of their products.

case2.description: Developed interfaces for Telegram Mini Apps and web applications. Built responsive screens and helped startups launch the first versions of their products.

case3.description: Developed the visual side of the MindMatch system. Built the main screens and user states for registration and sign-in.

case4.description: Converted Figma designs into working pages. Built responsive layouts for computers and phones, with close attention to spacing, typography, and components.

faq1.question: What kind of projects do you work on?
faq1.answer: I work on websites for small businesses, web applications, and Telegram Mini Apps. You can come to me with a new idea or a task for an existing project, and we'll define the right scope for it.

faq2.question: What exactly can you do?
faq2.answer: I can build an interface or develop a complete project with server-side logic, payments, a database, and a user dashboard. It can be a landing page, a corporate site, a marketplace, or a web application.

faq3.question: How long does a project take?
faq3.answer: The timeline depends on the number of pages, features, and available materials. A landing page usually takes 2–4 weeks; I estimate an application or platform after we discuss the task.

faq4.question: How is the cost calculated?
faq4.answer: The cost depends on the scope and complexity of the work. After our first discussion, I'll prepare an estimate with stages, timing, and a clear list of deliverables.

faq5.question: Do you provide support after launch?
faq5.answer: Yes. After launch I can fix bugs, update pages, and add new features. We'll agree on the scope and format of support separately.

Footer.title: Let's discuss your project
Footer.desc: Tell me what you want to build. We'll discuss the task, define the scope, and estimate the timeline.

two_pistolets.desc: A Telegram game with tasks, clans and a case store.
two_pistolets.concept: A dark interface with gold accents and mafia-themed illustrations.
two_pistolets.scope: Case store interface, daily and sponsored tasks, referral system and player profile.
two_pistolets.businessPain: Build an interface for a game with tasks, friend invitations and rewards.
two_pistolets.mechanism: Created the case store, task section, clans and player profile.
two_pistolets.businessResult: The app includes screens for completing tasks, viewing rewards and managing a clan.

code_venture.desc: A marketplace for ready-made applications and code, searchable by technology.
code_venture.concept: A dark theme with blue and purple accents. Cards and labels use technology names familiar to developers.
code_venture.scope: Landing page, catalog, technology filters, listing creation with a description generator and seller profile.
code_venture.businessPain: Create a place for developers to list projects and buyers to find them by features and technologies.
code_venture.mechanism: Built a filtered catalog, product listing flow and seller profile.
code_venture.businessResult: Buyers can inspect a project and its seller, while authors can prepare an application listing.

pashalka.desc: A Telegram promo-game builder with an admin panel and a player app.
pashalka.concept: A dark admin panel with bright accents. Game visuals can be adapted to the company's brand.
pashalka.scope: Bot profile, game asset library, subscription management, mini-game, leaderboard and reward store.
pashalka.businessPain: Let companies configure branded promo games and manage tasks.
pashalka.mechanism: Built the company dashboard and an app with gameplay, tasks and rewards.
pashalka.businessResult: Bot settings, game visuals and tasks are available in one dashboard, with a Telegram app for players.

upora.desc: A digital goods marketplace with buyer and creator accounts and Stripe payments.
upora.concept: Light and dark themes with large product previews and restrained navigation.
upora.scope: Searchable catalog, filters, product pages, recommendations, buyer and creator roles, and Stripe integration.
upora.businessPain: Build a digital product catalog with listing and purchasing tools.
upora.mechanism: Created the storefront, product pages and user accounts, and integrated Stripe payments.
upora.businessResult: Creators can list a product, while buyers can find it in the catalog and proceed to checkout.

moerodnoe.desc: A website for genealogist Dmitriy Gribkov, with services, work examples and consultation requests.
moerodnoe.concept: A beige and green palette with tree-branch motifs connects the design to family history.
moerodnoe.scope: Responsive page, service and pricing cards, video gallery, testimonials, consultation form and floating video player.
moerodnoe.businessPain: Present the genealogist's services and help visitors choose how to work with him.
moerodnoe.mechanism: Built service pages, a video gallery and a booking form, and added the founder's video introduction.
moerodnoe.businessResult: Visitors can explore services and work examples, meet the expert and request a consultation.

skin_space.desc: An interface for exchanging, buying and selling CS2 and DOTA 2 items.
skin_space.concept: A dark background with yellow accents. Inventory items and selection tools take up most of the interface.
skin_space.scope: Promotional sections, trading panel, game and rarity filters, and a profile with Steam settings.
skin_space.businessPain: Create an interface for selecting game items and managing inventory.
skin_space.mechanism: Built an inventory panel with search and filters, a user profile and Steam data integration.
skin_space.businessResult: Users can find items by game and rarity, inspect their inventory and enter Steam details in their profile.
